subject: Data Engineering
title: Streaming Use Cases
description: Learn Streaming Use Cases in one minute.

hook.text: Fraud detection, live dashboards, IoT monitoring, and ride-share pricing all depend on streaming data.

buildup.text: Any scenario where acting on stale data means lost value is a candidate for streaming.

discovery.text: Common patterns: real-time alerts, event-driven triggers, live aggregations, and continuous ETL.

twist.text: Not everything needs streaming. A monthly compliance report gains nothing from real-time ingestion.

climax.text: Choosing streaming vs batch depends on the cost of latency, not the trendiness of the technology.

punchline.text: Stream what must be fresh. Batch what can wait.

quiz.question: Which use case benefits most from streaming data?
